title: Update [CASE WHEN]
description:
## CASE WHEN in UPDATE
You can use CASE WHEN to update a column differently based on conditions - all in one statement instead of multiple UPDATEs.
```sql
UPDATE users SET health = 
    CASE
        WHEN age > 95 THEN 'healthy'
        WHEN age > 50 THEN 'warning'
        ELSE 'critical'
    END;
```
This updates every row's health based on its uptime. One query, all rows handled.

## Assignment:
BWS is reorganizing. Update all servers' status based on their cpu_cores:
- cpu_cores > 8 -> 'priority'
- cpu_cores > 4 -> 'standard'
- everything else -> 'decommission'
setupCode: CREATE TABLE servers (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT, cpu_cores INTEGER, status TEXT); INSERT INTO servers VALUES (1, 'prod-1', 8, 'running'), (2, 'prod-2', 16, 'running'), (3, 'staging-1', 4, 'stopped'), (4, 'dev-box', 2, 'on fire'), (5, 'test', 1, 'pending');
runHarness: SELECT * FROM servers ORDER BY id;
expectedOutput:
id | name | cpu_cores | status
1 | prod-1 | 8 | standard
2 | prod-2 | 16 | priority
3 | staging-1 | 4 | decommission
4 | dev-box | 2 | decommission
5 | test | 1 | decommission
